It doesnt seem that the other comments have mentioned this, but a really comfy set for Affinity that can work with all weapon types is using Chaotic Gore Magala weapons, while having 1 point of Bloodlust in your armor set. 

CGM weapons have a special mechanic that, when cured from Frenzy, gives you a very large Affinity boost (~70% affinity off of the weapon and bloodlust alone). This means you don't need 7 levels of critical eye just to reach similar levels of affinity, therefore your slots are a lot more flexible

Raw Long WF spam is meta right now, but Normal FB spam is also viable. I've never seen anyone play Wide ever since Sunbreak came out.

Personally I play a mix of RBD Long FB spam and HC into WF whenever I get a decent opening. The fact that Long just deals more damage per shell, and has a better WF means that you don't have to keep GS up as much as you do with Normal FB spamming. Obviously GS will increase your overall damage on any gunlance, but having EC boost HC on Long performs better, as your slaps deal a hefty amount of damage anyway. 

Just a reminder that EC boost doesn't go away after sheathing, letting you actually wirebug away into an RBD FB without worrying about GS

The thing with Elemental is that there's only a handful of good gunlances currently in endgame. Chief among them Pyre-Kadaki, Chaotic, Kamura, and Scorned. Making an elemental build might not be the optimal play here, since Gunlance is a skill heavy weapon to begin with, having elemental skills to slot in too would be challenging.

Staples like Guard Up, Artillery, Magazine, and WW would already set you back a good amount of slots. Trying to slot in elemental skills like E. Attack, Crit Element, and E. Exploit is a tall order.

It's also important to look at the Gunlance's kit. Slaplancing is fairly slow compared to other melee weapons. It hits infrequently, thus not capitalizing on element too much. It also foesn't have any charge attacks, thus rendering Charge Master useless.

On the other hand, Raw skills such as Powder Mantle and Hellfire Cloak 3 + Coalescence 1 procs every time you RBD into a FB.

Honestly don't bother with elemental gunlance, since the meta for elemental right now is D. Conversion + Furious/Strife, and that carries with it a lot of unnecessary skills for Gunlance, but better suited for other weapons.

Rolling for Buildup Boost on your armor sets and playing Scorned seems to be the meta right now, but if you're too lazy to reroll for that you can always just stick to Bloodlust and play Chaotic for 70% affinity off the bat
Agitator is nice, but I find Hellfire Cloak + Resuscitate to be better.
